newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 7.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Thursday:
* Caution seen again, as profit-taking pressure persists in recent rally bellwether electronics.
* Selling pressure especially strong among local securities investment trust firms, who posted net selling of T$6.76 billion on Wednesday.
* Record highs overnight on Wall Street, Nasdaq should give market some support, brokers say.
* Allen Huang, fund manager, National Securities: "Price-chasing willingness is just not strong right now."
* Huang: "Although the gains on Nasdaq and Wall Street should prevent a big fall in Taiwan, electronic shares are not ready to lead the market yet."
* Market closed at 9,861.47 on Wednesday, a loss of 0.59 percent or 58.21 points.
* Trading range for Thursday seen at 9,800-9,900.
